SIDBI's Working Capital facility provides MSME working capital finance, enabling Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to manage day-to-day cash flow and fund operating needs. Assistance is extended under the Working Capital (Cash Credit), DIGICash (Cash Credit and Overdraft) and STEP schemes.
The Working Capital scheme is a cash credit facility for MSMEs.
The DIGICash scheme is a digital working capital solution for MSMEs offering both cash credit and overdraft facilities.
The SIDBI STEP scheme (Term Loan to Enhance Production of MSMEs) is a working capital loan for MSMEs, offered as a term loan, to augment net working capital and/or execute urgent confirmed orders.

Working Capital: limits are need-based, as assessed by the Bank.
DIGICash: up to ₹5 crore.
STEP: up to ₹3 crore for existing customers and up to ₹2 crore for new customers.
Working Capital: both new and existing MSMEs with valid Udyam Registration, with a satisfactory credit history and no defaults to any bank or financial institution, are eligible to apply.
DIGICash: MSME units in operation for at least 2 years.
STEP: MSME units in operation for at least 3 years in case of new customers and 2 years for existing customers.
Working Capital / DIGICash: on demand.
STEP: repayment period up to 3 years.

A SIDBI working capital loan can be applied online. Applications are submitted through the "Apply Now" option on the SIDBI website, which opens the Bank's online loan application portal. Enterprises that need assistance in filing the application may approach nearest SIDBI Branch Office or a Referral Partner registered with SIDBI. For queries, call the toll-free number 180-022-6753 or WhatsApp +91 86930 33333.

Upgrade Your Products Or Operations, With Machinery Finance Solutions From SIDBI

SIDBI's Machinery Loan facility is a form of MSME equipment finance that enables Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to acquire new machinery and equipment for setting up new unit, capacity expansion, modernisation and technology upgradation of existing units. Assistance is extended under the EXPRESS, SPEED and UDAY schemes.
The EXPRESS scheme is a digitally assessed term loan facility targeted to existing entities with 3-year vintage, for the purchase of new machinery and equipment, with expeditious sanction.
The SIDBI SPEED scheme is SIDBI's machinery finance scheme, targeted to existing entities with 3-year vintage for the purchase of equipment, with expeditious sanction.

The UDAY scheme is SIDBI's machinery finance scheme targeted to new entities and existing entities having less than 3 years of vintage for purchase of new machinery and equipment, with expeditious sanction.
EXPRESS: up to ₹ 3 crore.
SPEED: up to ₹ 15 crore.
UDAY: up to ₹ 50 lakh.
EXPRESS: MSME units in operation for at least three years with mandatory GST registration.
SPEED: MSME units in operation for at least three years with cash profit in last 3 FYs.
UDAY: Greenfield/New MSME enterprise and existing MSME enterprise with less than 3 years of operations.
EXPRESS / UDAY: Repayment up to 60 months.
SPEED: Repayment up to 84 months.

A machinery purchase loan for MSMEs can be applied online. Applications are submitted through the "Apply Now" option on the SIDBI website, which opens the Bank's online loan application portal. Enterprises that need assistance in filing the application may approach nearest SIDBI Branch Office or a Referral Partner registered with SIDBI. For queries, call the toll-free number 180-022-6753 or WhatsApp +91 86930 33333.
